==Description==
'''D-35''' is a basic rusher. However, '''D-35''' can still be a tricky one.

==Behavior==
*When '''D-35''' spawns in, a deep boom will play, alongside global screen-shake that will occur. Depending on the current room's door number, '''D-35''' may rush slowly (low door number) or at ludicrous speed (extremely high door number). '''D-35''' when close will emit heavy static indicating that you should hide.
*Upon contact with the next room's door, '''D-35''' will make a portal beneath itself, and then use it to swiftly escape. In the process, '''D-35''' will smash down a weak door (Cave) or slam into a heavy door (Lab).
*Any player not hiding when seen by D-35 will instantly die, while not fully hiding when D-35 reaches current room will get half of there health taken away.

==Strategy & Tips==
*When you hear '''D-35'''<nowiki/>'s spawn sound, get near to a hiding spot immediately. After that wait until static starts to increase, then quickly enter the hiding spot.
*It is recommended that you stay near your locker when '''D-35''' has dissapeared, as [[D-35i]] could spawn.
*In the Red Rooms, '''D-35'''  can spawn passively
**Therefore, two of them can spawn at once
*'''D-35'''<nowiki/>'s instakill can be avoided by dodge-rolling, use this in dire situations when no hiding spots are available! You will still be damaged as if you were being lockersniped though.

==Trivia==
*'''D-35''' before did 10 damage when locker sniping instead of being 35 damage.
*'''D-35's''' jumpscare sound is from Jollibee's Phase 2 jumpscare, but with a much higher pitch.
* '''D-35's''' jumpscare sound was moderated temporaly, so there was a replacement for it from 3/6/26 to 5/16/26.
** It now has its original jumpscare back
